name: Real Love
overview: Real love, as revealed in Scripture, is grounded in the sacrificial giving of God, who loved the world so much that He gave His only Son to grant eternal life to believers (John 3:16). This love calls for a response of obedience to Christ’s commandments (John 14:15) and is exemplified supremely by laying down one’s life for others (John 15:13). Jesus commands believers to love one another with the same selfless love He demonstrated (John 13:34), recognizing that every word and action will be accounted for in the day of judgment (Matthew 12:36). Thus, real love is both a divine gift and a committed, obedient lifestyle shaped by Christ’s example.
